items.title: Carson Beck: Stays DNP on Thursday
items.text:
Beck (back) was listed as a non-participant on Thursday's injury report, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

items.title: Juwan Johnson: Day-to-day ahead of Sunday's contest
items.text:
Coach Kellen Moore said Thursday that Johnson (hamstring/wrist) is considered day-to-day ahead of Sunday's game against the Bengals, Katherine Terrell of ESPN reports.

items.title: Michael Pittman: Cleared for Friday's game
items.text:
